ncert_title: Physical Education: Relation with other Subjects

items.stem: What do you mean by physical education?
items.answer: Physical education is that part of education which aims at the optimum development of an individual through a continuous process of learning and participation in guided physical activities; in other words, it aims at optimum physical, mental and social development of an individual. It is an integral part of total education and makes a significant contribution towards the achievement of desirable educational and health outcomes.
grounding: Physical education (PE) aims at the optimum development of an individual through continuous process of learning and participation in guided physical activities.
In other words, it aims at optimum physical, mental and social development of an individual.
In fact, PE is an integral part of total education.
It makes significant contribution towards the achievement of desirable educational and health outcomes.

items.stem: What is the contribution of science subjects to physical education?
items.answer: The human body is a common concern of both science and health and physical education. In science, students study the human body from the cellular level to the systems level, with a focus on anatomy and physiology, while in health and physical education learning is focused on the requirements for good health and the promotion of a healthy body. Using science, students can link the functioning of the musculo-skeletal, digestive, endocrine and nervous systems to the promotion of the physical, social, mental and emotional health of individuals within a society. Science also contributes in the designing of training for movements of organs to achieve optimal performance in the area of play, sports and games.
grounding: The human body is a common concern of both science and health and physical education.
In science, students study the human body from the cellular level to the systems level, with a focus on anatomy and physiology.
In health and physical education learning is focused on the requirements for good health and the promotion of a healthy body.

Students gain an understanding of the role of physical and yogic activities in ensuring good health and can link the functioning of the musculo-skeletal, digestive, endocrine and nervous systems studied in science, for the promotion of the physical, social, mental and emotional health of individuals within a society.
It also contributes in the designing of training for movements of organs to achieve optimal performance in the area of play, sports and games.

items.stem: "Although physical education uses content from several disciplines, it is fast emerging as a discipline." Write two arguments favouring this statement.
items.answer: (a) Physical education has its own body of study and not only borrowed content: the meaning and definition of Physical Education, its aims and objectives and scope, and factors affecting physical fitness and wellness, rules and other necessary knowledge about health, games and sports and yoga are major areas of study in physical education. (b) It has evolved as a multi-disciplinary subject whose scope is not just confined to physical fitness and the rules of games and sports, and areas such as cultural heritage, development of leadership qualities and group dynamics through sports and games are an integral part of this discipline itself. On these grounds PE stands as an integral part of total education in its own right.
grounding: Physical education has evolved as a multi-disciplinary subject and its scope is not just confined to physical fitness and the rules of games and sports.

The meaning and definition of Physical Education, its aims and objectives and scope, and factors affecting physical fitness and wellness, rules and other necessary knowledge about health, games and sports and yoga are major areas of study in physical education.
Games and sports, as well as, cultural heritage, development of leadership qualities and group dynamics through sports and games are also an integral part of this discipline.
In fact, PE is an integral part of total education.

items.stem: Who is a physically fit person?
items.answer: A physically fit person is one who is in the state where an individual is physically fit and has developed great endurance, speed and strength. Physical fitness is essential for leading a happy, healthy, vigorous and fulfilling life, and physical and motor fitness also helps such a person to learn and develop technical and tactical knowledge of sports and games.
grounding: It refers to the state where an individual is physically fit and has developed great endurance, speed and strength.
Physical fitness is essential for leading a happy, healthy, vigorous and fulfilling life.
Physical and motor fitness helps to learn and develop technical and tactical knowledge of sports and games.

items.stem: Should physical education and sports be an integral part of learning? Justify your answer. Give at least three reasons.
items.answer: Yes, physical education and sports should be an integral part of learning. (1) PE is an integral part of total education and it makes significant contribution towards the achievement of desirable educational and health outcomes. (2) Health: by engaging in various physical and yogic activities, one can ensure a healthy lifestyle. (3) Academic achievement: research evidence has shown that students tend to do better in school when they participate in physical activities, and there is a positive correlation between performance in sport and the level of academic achievement; by participating in these activities students also get stimulated to face challenges and are encouraged to think productively. (4) Social development: physical education activities provide ample opportunities to develop such traits and life skills as cooperation, respect for others, loyalty, sportspersonship and self-confidence, and all these qualities help a person to become more social and a responsible citizen. (5) Lifelong benefit: it enables children to acquire the necessary knowledge and skills to stimulate them to actively participate in physical activities throughout their lifespan.
grounding: In fact, PE is an integral part of total education.
It makes significant contribution towards the achievement of desirable educational and health outcomes.
It also enables children to acquire necessary knowledge and skills to stimulate them to actively participate in physical activities throughout their lifespan.
By engaging in various physical and yogic activities, one can ensure a healthy lifestyle.
By participating in various physical and yogic activities, students get stimulated to face challenges and are encouraged to think productively.
research evidence has shown that students tend to do better in school when they participate in physical activities
There is a positive correlation between performance in sport and the level of academic achievement.
Physical education activities provide ample opportunities to develop such traits and life skills as cooperation, respect for others, loyalty, sportspersonship, self-confidence, etc.
All these qualities help a person to become more social and a responsible citizen.

items.stem: "All sports can be games, but not all games can be sports" Give at least two arguments for or against the statement.
items.answer: (a) Play is a broad area which includes both games and sports, and games are also played on the basis of a set of rules, so a sport can be looked at as a game; but by masses, games are played primarily for entertainment or enjoyment, whereas a sport is a physical activity carried out under an agreed set of rules, for competition or self-enjoyment or a combination of these, and the difference of purpose differentiates sport from game, combined with the notion of individual or team skill. (b) Sport are the kind of activities in which similar kind of body movement is repeated over a long time and in which the mental capabilities of the sportsperson are judged, and it is the sportsperson or the individual who determines the outcome; a game without these features does not become a sport, which is also why a person who participates in a game is known as a player while a person participating in a sport is called an athlete or a sportsperson.
grounding: Play, however, is a broad area which includes both games and sports.
A game is an activity involving more players, defined by a goal that the players tries to reach, and some set rules to play.
By masses, games are played primarily for entertainment or enjoyment.
The difference of purpose differentiates sport from game, combined with the notion of individual or team skill.
Games are also played on the basis of a set of rules.
A person who participates in a game is known as a player.
A sport is a physical activity carried out under an agreed set of rules, for competition or self-enjoyment or a combination of these.
Sport are the kind of activities in which similar kind of body movement is repeated over a long time.
Sport involves an activity or activities where the mental capabilities of the sportsperson are judged.
In a sport, it is the sportsperson or the individual who determines the outcome.
A person participating in a sport is called an athlete or a sportsperson.
